title: STEM Bridge Scholarship
description: Full scholarships keep students from public and community schools on track at Tribhuvan, Kathmandu University, and CTEVT campuses by covering tuition balances, hostels, lab fees, and a rugged laptop.
teaser: Tuition, hostels, labs, and laptops for students transitioning into Nepali universities.
bullets: Career coaching with alumni at Deerwalk, Fusemachines, Khalti, and Vianet
Emergency stipends for healthcare, visas, or family crises
Peer accountability circles facilitated by Teach For Nepal alumni
impact: Impact: 110 scholars have earned STEM degrees since 2018 with 78% staying in Nepal’s tech sector.

image.alt: Students learning in a computer lab supported by Aashirbad Foundation

title: Future Coders Fellowship
description: Weekend labs in Janakpur, Pokhara, and Surkhet blend Scratch, Python, GIS, and climate data so students can solve hyperlocal problems with mentors from Karkhana Samuha and Girls in Tech Nepal.
teaser: Community labs with Nepali mentors, refurbished tablets, and Nepali-language curriculum.
bullets: Monthly hack days co-hosted with public schools and municipal ICT clubs
Hardware library with tablets, routers, and solar chargers
Travel meals and SIM top-ups for students commuting from villages
impact: Impact: 75% of fellows publish their first apps or dashboards before SEE exams.

title: Bridge to University Fund
description: One-time grants help scholars from Karnali, Sudurpaschim, and Madhesh provinces cover SEE bridge courses, entrance prep, travel, and the first three months in Kathmandu.
teaser: Bridge grants cover travel, prep classes, and the first hostel payment when scholars relocate.
bullets: Partner hostels vetted with local child-protection groups
Family counseling sessions in Nepali, Maithili, and Tharu
Microcapital for caregivers to offset lost household income
impact: Impact: 60 students relocated safely and completed year one without dropping out.

image.alt: Mentor helping a student on laptop

title: Women in Tech Leadership Labs
description: Intensive cohorts held with Women Leaders in Technology, Girls in Tech Nepal, and FNCCI chapters help women scholars design social enterprises serving their home districts.
teaser: Leadership intensives plus mini-grants so women technologists can launch community ventures.
bullets: Pitch coaching with mentors from Khalti, eSewa, and CloudFactory
Connections to Nepal Communitere, Antarprerana, and SAFAL accelerators
Mini-grants for prototypes tackling health, agri-tech, or local governance challenges
impact: Impact: 30 alumni have launched community technology initiatives employing 86 women locally.

title: Digital Access Fund
description: Provides tablets, offline Wikipedia + E-Pustakalaya bundles, and reliable connectivity so rural libraries become digital study spaces aligned with the Digital Nepal Framework.
teaser: Devices, offline curriculum, and Wi-Fi cooperatives powering rural STEM classrooms.
bullets: Community Wi-Fi hubs run with Nepal Internet Exchange and local cooperatives
Tech support hotline staffed by university volunteers in Pokhara and Kathmandu
Localized Nepali-English STEM curriculum referencing CDC and UNESCO resources
impact: Impact: 1,200+ devices and 42 mesh Wi-Fi nodes across 25 districts.
